(function () {
    'use strict';

    const CONFIG = {
        skuEndpoint: 'https://cdn0.woolworths.media/wowssr/assets/tga-sku.json',
        buttonLabel: 'View Details',
        targetSkus: [],
        isInitialized: false,
        tracking: {
            enabled: true,
            category: 'SKU Replacement',
            action: 'View Details Click',
            labelPrefix: 'SKU: '
        }
    };

    function triggerTracking(sku) {
        if (!CONFIG.tracking.enabled) return;
        if (typeof (utag) !== 'undefined') { 
            utag.link({ 
                'event.Category': CONFIG.tracking.category, 
                'event.Action': CONFIG.tracking.action, 
                'event.Label': CONFIG.tracking.labelPrefix + sku 
            });
        }
    }

    const SHADOW_CSS = `
        .custom-view-details-btn {
            --background: var(--color-action-background-primary-default);
            --font-size: var(--font-title-sm-default-size);
            --height: 3rem;
            --line-height: var(--font-body-md-default-line-height);
            --padding-horizontal: var(--space-content-sm);
            --padding-vertical: var(--space-internal-lg);
            --text-color: var(--color-action-text-primary-default);
            background-color: var(--background);
            color: var(--text-color);
            height: var(--height);
            padding: var(--padding-vertical) var(--padding-horizontal);
            border: none;
            border-radius: var(--radius-action);
            cursor: pointer;
            display: inline-flex;
            font-family: inherit;
            font-size: var(--font-size);
            font-weight: var(--font-weight-medium);
            gap: var(--space-internal-sm);
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            line-height: var(--line-height);
            text-decoration: none;
            width: 100%;
            box-sizing: border-box;
            margin-bottom: 0 !important;
            outline: none;
            vertical-align: middle;
        }
        .custom-view-details-btn:hover {
            --background: var(--color-action-background-primary-focus);
            --text-color: var(--color-action-text-primary-focus);
            background-color: var(--background);
            color: var(--text-color);
        }
        .product-tile-body.video-ad-unit-horizontal .custom-view-details-btn {
        width: auto;
        flex-grow:1;
        order: 2;
        }
    `;

    function handleShadowTiles() {
        if (!CONFIG.isInitialized) return;
        document.querySelectorAll('wc-product-tile').forEach(tile => {
            const shadow = tile.shadowRoot;
            if (!shadow) return;
            const link = shadow.querySelector('a[href*="/shop/productdetails/"]');
            if (link) {
                const skuMatch = link.getAttribute("href").match(/\/productdetails\/(\d+)\//);
                const sku = skuMatch ? parseInt(skuMatch[1], 10) : null;
                if (sku && CONFIG.targetSkus.includes(sku)) {
                    if (!shadow.querySelector('style[data-custom-style]')) {
                        const st = document.createElement("style");
                        st.setAttribute("data-custom-style", "true");
                        st.textContent = SHADOW_CSS;
                        shadow.appendChild(st);
                    }
                    const originalCart = shadow.querySelector("wc-add-to-cart");
                    if (originalCart && !shadow.querySelector(".custom-view-details-btn")) {
                        const newBtn = document.createElement("a");
                        newBtn.className = "custom-view-details-btn";
                        newBtn.href = link.getAttribute("href");
                        newBtn.textContent = CONFIG.buttonLabel;
                        newBtn.addEventListener('click', () => triggerTracking(sku));
                        originalCart.replaceWith(newBtn);
                    }
                }
            }
        });
    }

    function handleStandardLists() {
        if (!CONFIG.isInitialized) return;
        document.querySelectorAll('#sf-product-varieties-list li').forEach(li => {
            const skuInput = li.querySelector('.sf-stockcode');
            const skuStr = skuInput ? skuInput.value : li.id?.split('-').pop();
            const sku = parseInt(skuStr, 10);
            if (!isNaN(sku) && CONFIG.targetSkus.includes(sku)) {
                const cartContainer = li.querySelector('.sf-variety-addtocart-container');
                const oosContainer = li.querySelector('.sf-variety-oos-container');
                if (cartContainer) {
                    const origBtn = cartContainer.querySelector('.cartControls-addButton');
                    if (origBtn) origBtn.remove(); 
                }
                const targetContainer = (cartContainer && getComputedStyle(cartContainer).display !== 'none') ? cartContainer : oosContainer;
                if (targetContainer && !li.querySelector('.custom-view-details-btn-standard')) {
                    const newBtn = document.createElement('a');
                    newBtn.className = "custom-view-details-btn-standard";
                    newBtn.href = "/shop/productdetails/" + sku;
                    newBtn.textContent = CONFIG.buttonLabel;
                    newBtn.addEventListener('click', () => triggerTracking(sku));
                    targetContainer.prepend(newBtn);
                }
            }
        });


    }

    function handleCmpProductCards() {
        if (!CONFIG.isInitialized) return;

        // 1. Handle Active Add to Cart components
        document.querySelectorAll('cmp-add-to-cart-button:not(.js-custom-replaced)').forEach(cartComp => {
            const skuStr = cartComp.getAttribute('stockcode');
            replaceCmpButton(cartComp, skuStr);
        });

        // 2. Handle Static Out of Stock buttons
        document.querySelectorAll('.btn-outofstock:not(.js-custom-replaced)').forEach(oosBtn => {
            const parentCard = oosBtn.closest('.cmp-product-card');
            if (!parentCard) return;

            // Attempt to find SKU from "Save to list" button ID or product link
            const saveToListBtn = parentCard.querySelector('.btn-savetolist');
            const productLink = parentCard.querySelector('a.cmp-product-card-image-wrapper');
            
            let skuStr = null;
            if (saveToListBtn && saveToListBtn.id) {
                skuStr = saveToListBtn.id.split('-').reverse()[1]; // Extracts SKU from ID format
            } else if (productLink) {
                const match = productLink.href.match(/\/productdetails\/(\d+)\//);
                skuStr = match ? match[1] : null;
            }

            if (skuStr) replaceCmpButton(oosBtn, skuStr);
        });
    }

    function replaceCmpButton(targetElement, skuStr) {
        const sku = parseInt(skuStr, 10);
        if (sku && CONFIG.targetSkus.includes(sku)) {
            const newBtn = document.createElement('a');
            newBtn.className = "btn js-custom-replaced"; 
            newBtn.href = "/shop/productdetails/" + sku;
            newBtn.textContent = CONFIG.buttonLabel;
            newBtn.style.display = "flex";
            newBtn.style.width = "100%";
            newBtn.style.justifyContent = "center";
            newBtn.style.alignItems = "center";
            newBtn.style.textDecoration = "none";
            newBtn.style.opacity = "1"; // Ensure it's visible even if replacing a disabled button
            newBtn.style.cursor = "pointer";

            newBtn.addEventListener('click', () => triggerTracking(sku));
            targetElement.replaceWith(newBtn);
        }
    }

    function runAllHandlers() {
        // handleShadowTiles();
        handleStandardLists();
        // handleCmpProductCards();
    }

    async function init() {
        const observer = new MutationObserver(runAllHandlers);
        observer.observe(document.documentElement, { childList: true, subtree: true });

        try {
            const response = await fetch(CONFIG.skuEndpoint);
            if (!response.ok) return;
            const data = await response.json();
            if (Array.isArray(data)) {
                CONFIG.targetSkus = data;
                CONFIG.isInitialized = true;
                runAllHandlers();
            }
        } catch (e) {
            console.error("[SKU-Manager] Init error:", e);
        }
    }

    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
    } else {
        init();
    }

})();

(function () {
    'use strict';

    const CONFIG = {
        skuEndpoint: 'https://cdn0.woolworths.media/wowssr/assets/tga-sku.json',
        buttonLabel: 'View Details',
        targetSkus: [],
        isInitialized: false,
        tracking: {
            enabled: true,
            category: 'SKU Replacement',
            action: 'View Details Click',
            labelPrefix: 'SKU: '
        }
    };

    function triggerTracking(sku) {
        if (!CONFIG.tracking.enabled) return;
        if (typeof (utag) !== 'undefined') { 
            utag.link({ 
                'event.Category': CONFIG.tracking.category, 
                'event.Action': CONFIG.tracking.action, 
                'event.Label': CONFIG.tracking.labelPrefix + sku 
            });
        }
    }

    const SHADOW_CSS = `
        .custom-view-details-btn {
            --background: var(--color-action-background-primary-default);
            --font-size: var(--font-title-sm-default-size);
            --height: 3rem;
            --line-height: var(--font-body-md-default-line-height);
            --padding-horizontal: var(--space-content-sm);
            --padding-vertical: var(--space-internal-lg);
            --text-color: var(--color-action-text-primary-default);
            background-color: var(--background);
            color: var(--text-color);
            height: var(--height);
            padding: var(--padding-vertical) var(--padding-horizontal);
            border: none;
            border-radius: var(--radius-action);
            cursor: pointer;
            display: inline-flex;
            font-family: inherit;
            font-size: var(--font-size);
            font-weight: var(--font-weight-medium);
            gap: var(--space-internal-sm);
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            line-height: var(--line-height);
            text-decoration: none;
            width: 100%;
            box-sizing: border-box;
            margin-bottom: 0 !important;
            outline: none;
            vertical-align: middle;
        }
        .custom-view-details-btn:hover {
            --background: var(--color-action-background-primary-focus);
            --text-color: var(--color-action-text-primary-focus);
            background-color: var(--background);
            color: var(--text-color);
        }
        .product-tile-body.video-ad-unit-horizontal .custom-view-details-btn {
        width: auto;
        flex-grow:1;
        order: 2;
        }
    `;

    function handleShadowTiles() {
        if (!CONFIG.isInitialized) return;
        document.querySelectorAll('wc-product-tile').forEach(tile => {
            const shadow = tile.shadowRoot;
            if (!shadow) return;
            const link = shadow.querySelector('a[href*="/shop/productdetails/"]');
            if (link) {
                const skuMatch = link.getAttribute("href").match(/\/productdetails\/(\d+)\//);
                const sku = skuMatch ? parseInt(skuMatch[1], 10) : null;
                if (sku && CONFIG.targetSkus.includes(sku)) {
                    if (!shadow.querySelector('style[data-custom-style]')) {
                        const st = document.createElement("style");
                        st.setAttribute("data-custom-style", "true");
                        st.textContent = SHADOW_CSS;
                        shadow.appendChild(st);
                    }
                    const originalCart = shadow.querySelector("wc-add-to-cart");
                    if (originalCart && !shadow.querySelector(".custom-view-details-btn")) {
                        const newBtn = document.createElement("a");
                        newBtn.className = "custom-view-details-btn";
                        newBtn.href = link.getAttribute("href");
                        newBtn.textContent = CONFIG.buttonLabel;
                        newBtn.addEventListener('click', () => triggerTracking(sku));
                        originalCart.replaceWith(newBtn);
                    }
                }
            }
        });
    }

    function handleStandardLists() {
        if (!CONFIG.isInitialized) return;
        document.querySelectorAll('#sf-product-varieties-list li').forEach(li => {
            const skuInput = li.querySelector('.sf-stockcode');
            const skuStr = skuInput ? skuInput.value : li.id?.split('-').pop();
            const sku = parseInt(skuStr, 10);
            if (!isNaN(sku) && CONFIG.targetSkus.includes(sku)) {
                const cartContainer = li.querySelector('.sf-variety-addtocart-container');
                const oosContainer = li.querySelector('.sf-variety-oos-container');
                if (cartContainer) {
                    const origBtn = cartContainer.querySelector('.cartControls-addButton');
                    if (origBtn) origBtn.remove(); 
                }
                const targetContainer = (cartContainer && getComputedStyle(cartContainer).display !== 'none') ? cartContainer : oosContainer;
                if (targetContainer && !li.querySelector('.custom-view-details-btn-standard')) {
                    const newBtn = document.createElement('a');
                    newBtn.className = "custom-view-details-btn-standard";
                    newBtn.href = "/shop/productdetails/" + sku;
                    newBtn.textContent = CONFIG.buttonLabel;
                    newBtn.addEventListener('click', () => triggerTracking(sku));
                    targetContainer.prepend(newBtn);
                }
            }
        });


    }

    function handleCmpProductCards() {
        if (!CONFIG.isInitialized) return;

        // 1. Handle Active Add to Cart components
        document.querySelectorAll('cmp-add-to-cart-button:not(.js-custom-replaced)').forEach(cartComp => {
            const skuStr = cartComp.getAttribute('stockcode');
            replaceCmpButton(cartComp, skuStr);
        });

        // 2. Handle Static Out of Stock buttons
        document.querySelectorAll('.btn-outofstock:not(.js-custom-replaced)').forEach(oosBtn => {
            const parentCard = oosBtn.closest('.cmp-product-card');
            if (!parentCard) return;

            // Attempt to find SKU from "Save to list" button ID or product link
            const saveToListBtn = parentCard.querySelector('.btn-savetolist');
            const productLink = parentCard.querySelector('a.cmp-product-card-image-wrapper');
            
            let skuStr = null;
            if (saveToListBtn && saveToListBtn.id) {
                skuStr = saveToListBtn.id.split('-').reverse()[1]; // Extracts SKU from ID format
            } else if (productLink) {
                const match = productLink.href.match(/\/productdetails\/(\d+)\//);
                skuStr = match ? match[1] : null;
            }

            if (skuStr) replaceCmpButton(oosBtn, skuStr);
        });
    }

    function replaceCmpButton(targetElement, skuStr) {
        const sku = parseInt(skuStr, 10);
        if (sku && CONFIG.targetSkus.includes(sku)) {
            const newBtn = document.createElement('a');
            newBtn.className = "btn js-custom-replaced"; 
            newBtn.href = "/shop/productdetails/" + sku;
            newBtn.textContent = CONFIG.buttonLabel;
            newBtn.style.display = "flex";
            newBtn.style.width = "100%";
            newBtn.style.justifyContent = "center";
            newBtn.style.alignItems = "center";
            newBtn.style.textDecoration = "none";
            newBtn.style.opacity = "1"; // Ensure it's visible even if replacing a disabled button
            newBtn.style.cursor = "pointer";

            newBtn.addEventListener('click', () => triggerTracking(sku));
            targetElement.replaceWith(newBtn);
        }
    }

    function runAllHandlers() {
        // handleShadowTiles();
        handleStandardLists();
        // handleCmpProductCards();
    }

    async function init() {
        const observer = new MutationObserver(runAllHandlers);
        observer.observe(document.documentElement, { childList: true, subtree: true });

        try {
            const response = await fetch(CONFIG.skuEndpoint);
            if (!response.ok) return;
            const data = await response.json();
            if (Array.isArray(data)) {
                CONFIG.targetSkus = data;
                CONFIG.isInitialized = true;
                runAllHandlers();
            }
        } catch (e) {
            console.error("[SKU-Manager] Init error:", e);
        }
    }

    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
    } else {
        init();
    }

})();

(function () {
    'use strict';

    const CONFIG = {
        skuEndpoint: 'https://cdn0.woolworths.media/wowssr/assets/tga-sku.json',
        buttonLabel: 'View Details',
        targetSkus: [],
        isInitialized: false,
        tracking: {
            enabled: true,
            category: 'SKU Replacement',
            action: 'View Details Click',
            labelPrefix: 'SKU: '
        }
    };

    function triggerTracking(sku) {
        if (!CONFIG.tracking.enabled) return;
        if (typeof (utag) !== 'undefined') { 
            utag.link({ 
                'event.Category': CONFIG.tracking.category, 
                'event.Action': CONFIG.tracking.action, 
                'event.Label': CONFIG.tracking.labelPrefix + sku 
            });
        }
    }

    const SHADOW_CSS = `
        .custom-view-details-btn {
            --background: var(--color-action-background-primary-default);
            --font-size: var(--font-title-sm-default-size);
            --height: 3rem;
            --line-height: var(--font-body-md-default-line-height);
            --padding-horizontal: var(--space-content-sm);
            --padding-vertical: var(--space-internal-lg);
            --text-color: var(--color-action-text-primary-default);
            background-color: var(--background);
            color: var(--text-color);
            height: var(--height);
            padding: var(--padding-vertical) var(--padding-horizontal);
            border: none;
            border-radius: var(--radius-action);
            cursor: pointer;
            display: inline-flex;
            font-family: inherit;
            font-size: var(--font-size);
            font-weight: var(--font-weight-medium);
            gap: var(--space-internal-sm);
            justify-content: center;
            align-items: center;
            line-height: var(--line-height);
            text-decoration: none;
            width: 100%;
            box-sizing: border-box;
            margin-bottom: 0 !important;
            outline: none;
            vertical-align: middle;
        }
        .custom-view-details-btn:hover {
            --background: var(--color-action-background-primary-focus);
            --text-color: var(--color-action-text-primary-focus);
            background-color: var(--background);
            color: var(--text-color);
        }
        .product-tile-body.video-ad-unit-horizontal .custom-view-details-btn {
        width: auto;
        flex-grow:1;
        order: 2;
        }
    `;

    function handleShadowTiles() {
        if (!CONFIG.isInitialized) return;
        document.querySelectorAll('wc-product-tile').forEach(tile => {
            const shadow = tile.shadowRoot;
            if (!shadow) return;
            const link = shadow.querySelector('a[href*="/shop/productdetails/"]');
            if (link) {
                const skuMatch = link.getAttribute("href").match(/\/productdetails\/(\d+)\//);
                const sku = skuMatch ? parseInt(skuMatch[1], 10) : null;
                if (sku && CONFIG.targetSkus.includes(sku)) {
                    if (!shadow.querySelector('style[data-custom-style]')) {
                        const st = document.createElement("style");
                        st.setAttribute("data-custom-style", "true");
                        st.textContent = SHADOW_CSS;
                        shadow.appendChild(st);
                    }
                    const originalCart = shadow.querySelector("wc-add-to-cart");
                    if (originalCart && !shadow.querySelector(".custom-view-details-btn")) {
                        const newBtn = document.createElement("a");
                        newBtn.className = "custom-view-details-btn";
                        newBtn.href = link.getAttribute("href");
                        newBtn.textContent = CONFIG.buttonLabel;
                        newBtn.addEventListener('click', () => triggerTracking(sku));
                        originalCart.replaceWith(newBtn);
                    }
                }
            }
        });
    }

    function handleStandardLists() {
        if (!CONFIG.isInitialized) return;
        document.querySelectorAll('#sf-product-varieties-list li').forEach(li => {
            const skuInput = li.querySelector('.sf-stockcode');
            const skuStr = skuInput ? skuInput.value : li.id?.split('-').pop();
            const sku = parseInt(skuStr, 10);
            if (!isNaN(sku) && CONFIG.targetSkus.includes(sku)) {
                const cartContainer = li.querySelector('.sf-variety-addtocart-container');
                const oosContainer = li.querySelector('.sf-variety-oos-container');
                if (cartContainer) {
                    const origBtn = cartContainer.querySelector('.cartControls-addButton');
                    if (origBtn) origBtn.remove(); 
                }
                const targetContainer = (cartContainer && getComputedStyle(cartContainer).display !== 'none') ? cartContainer : oosContainer;
                if (targetContainer && !li.querySelector('.custom-view-details-btn-standard')) {
                    const newBtn = document.createElement('a');
                    newBtn.className = "custom-view-details-btn-standard";
                    newBtn.href = "/shop/productdetails/" + sku;
                    newBtn.textContent = CONFIG.buttonLabel;
                    newBtn.addEventListener('click', () => triggerTracking(sku));
                    targetContainer.prepend(newBtn);
                }
            }
        });


    }

    function handleCmpProductCards() {
        if (!CONFIG.isInitialized) return;

        // 1. Handle Active Add to Cart components
        document.querySelectorAll('cmp-add-to-cart-button:not(.js-custom-replaced)').forEach(cartComp => {
            const skuStr = cartComp.getAttribute('stockcode');
            replaceCmpButton(cartComp, skuStr);
        });

        // 2. Handle Static Out of Stock buttons
        document.querySelectorAll('.btn-outofstock:not(.js-custom-replaced)').forEach(oosBtn => {
            const parentCard = oosBtn.closest('.cmp-product-card');
            if (!parentCard) return;

            // Attempt to find SKU from "Save to list" button ID or product link
            const saveToListBtn = parentCard.querySelector('.btn-savetolist');
            const productLink = parentCard.querySelector('a.cmp-product-card-image-wrapper');
            
            let skuStr = null;
            if (saveToListBtn && saveToListBtn.id) {
                skuStr = saveToListBtn.id.split('-').reverse()[1]; // Extracts SKU from ID format
            } else if (productLink) {
                const match = productLink.href.match(/\/productdetails\/(\d+)\//);
                skuStr = match ? match[1] : null;
            }

            if (skuStr) replaceCmpButton(oosBtn, skuStr);
        });
    }

    function replaceCmpButton(targetElement, skuStr) {
        const sku = parseInt(skuStr, 10);
        if (sku && CONFIG.targetSkus.includes(sku)) {
            const newBtn = document.createElement('a');
            newBtn.className = "btn js-custom-replaced"; 
            newBtn.href = "/shop/productdetails/" + sku;
            newBtn.textContent = CONFIG.buttonLabel;
            newBtn.style.display = "flex";
            newBtn.style.width = "100%";
            newBtn.style.justifyContent = "center";
            newBtn.style.alignItems = "center";
            newBtn.style.textDecoration = "none";
            newBtn.style.opacity = "1"; // Ensure it's visible even if replacing a disabled button
            newBtn.style.cursor = "pointer";

            newBtn.addEventListener('click', () => triggerTracking(sku));
            targetElement.replaceWith(newBtn);
        }
    }

    function runAllHandlers() {
        // handleShadowTiles();
        handleStandardLists();
        // handleCmpProductCards();
    }

    async function init() {
        const observer = new MutationObserver(runAllHandlers);
        observer.observe(document.documentElement, { childList: true, subtree: true });

        try {
            const response = await fetch(CONFIG.skuEndpoint);
            if (!response.ok) return;
            const data = await response.json();
            if (Array.isArray(data)) {
                CONFIG.targetSkus = data;
                CONFIG.isInitialized = true;
                runAllHandlers();
            }
        } catch (e) {
            console.error("[SKU-Manager] Init error:", e);
        }
    }

    if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
        document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
    } else {
        init();
    }

})();
